tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Run a full AI-readiness (AEO) audit of a website: 29 checks across AI crawler access, structured data, content extractability, and answerability, returning a 0-100 score with prioritized fixes. Use when asked how visible a site is to ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Claude, or for an overall AEO/AI-SEO health check.

url.description: Website URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Check whether AI crawlers like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, and Bingbot are allowed to read a website, based on its robots.txt. Use when asked about AI visibility, AEO, crawler permissions, or why a site does not appear in ChatGPT or Perplexity.

url.description: Website URL, e.g. https://example.com (robots.txt is derived from it)

tools.name: inspect_llms_txt
tools.description: Fetch and validate a website's llms.txt file (the Markdown file that tells AI engines what the site is about and which pages matter). Returns its title, summary, sections, links, and any structural issues. Use when asked whether a site has llms.txt or how to improve it.

url.description: Website URL, e.g. https://example.com (llms.txt is derived from it)

tools.name: extract_structured_data
tools.description: Extract and summarize a page's JSON-LD structured data (schema.org): which types exist (Product, Article, FAQPage, Organization), their key fields, and any parse errors. Use when asked whether a page has the schema markup AI answer engines rely on for citations.

url.description: Page URL to extract structured data from

tools.name: extract_page_signals
tools.description: Extract the on-page signals AI engines parse: title, meta description, h1, canonical, lang, text-to-HTML ratio, heading outline, and whether the page looks client-side rendered (invisible to most AI crawlers). Use to diagnose why engines misread or skip a page.

url.description: Page URL to extract signals from
